items.title: Unusual Machines Is Down 47% in a Month. Can UMAC Stock Hit Oppenheimer’s $30 Target by 2030?
items.summary: Wall Street just slapped a bullish target on this drone-parts maker, yet the shares kept sliding. With Detroit automakers eyeing its core product and fresh stock hitting the market, can strong sales and a big cash pile still win over skeptics?

items.title: Ford to acquire minority stake in satellite maker Revolution Space
items.summary: The automaker made an undisclosed investment in Revolution Space through its subsidiary, Industrial Platform. The companies will work together to scale production of spacecraft and related components.

items.title: GM, Ford in Pentagon Talks to Build Military Drones
items.summary: The U.S. military is exploring partnerships with automakers to expand domestic defense manufacturing capacity.

items.title: Red Cat Sinks 9%, Unusual Machines Slides 7%, Ondas Drops 4%: Is the Pentagon’s Reported Push to Bring In General Motors and Ford a Threat to Drone Stocks?
items.summary: The Pentagon wants millions of drones, and Detroit may be the answer. Small drone makers like Red Cat face a question that could make automakers either their biggest rival or their most useful supplier.

items.title: Tesla’s Europe Sales Soar 84%
items.summary: Europe is buying Tesla at a pace that outruns the entire EV market, while American drivers keep their distance. One tariff wall and a stalled US appetite for electric cars may decide whether Tesla's overseas momentum ever comes home.
